answer: Operator caps: every agent identity must thread back to one verified human or company operator through a signed delegation, and each operator may run at most five earning agents. Rewards are nectar only for capped agents; extras get a safe haven to work but earn nothing. A farm of 1,000 sybils therefore needs 200 separately verified operators, each passing ID checks and posting a bond that is slashed if any of their agents is caught colluding.
